findings.problem: The criterion is conditioned on a raise happening while the modal is open, and the test never raised anything. A shared modal/modeless stack -- the regression the criterion exists for -- would have passed.
findings.resolution: A pointerdown is dispatched at a window's title bar while the modal is up, the raise is asserted to have taken effect, and only then are the modal's z-order, Tab containment and Escape re-checked.

findings.problem: Only the horizontal axis was asserted; the criterion names width and height.
findings.resolution: Height equality and vertical containment added.

findings.problem: The neighbour-overlap loop skipped a null box, so finding no neighbours at all would have reported the clause as satisfied.
findings.resolution: Neighbours are collected and counted before the loop runs.

findings.problem: Only docked and stage were exercised; the criterion names floating as well.
findings.resolution: A title bar drag puts the window into floating and the control is asserted enabled there.

findings.problem: Only the stored size was excluded; a rect keeping the stored origin would have passed.
findings.resolution: x and y are excluded too, and the box is asserted to sit inside the stage.

findings.problem: A dispatched event cannot show that the default action still happens, only that preventDefault was not called.
findings.resolution: A real mouse press follows, and the caret is asserted to have landed inside the editor content.

findings.problem: Surface hiding is explained by the tab rule alone, so it cannot carry the causal clause.
findings.resolution: Kept as a synchronisation wait; the substance of the assertion is the registry entry itself.

findings.problem: The debug hook's declared shape carries a rect field no assertion reads.
findings.resolution: Kept deliberately: the hook returns the registry entry as it is, and a projection would misdescribe what was read.

findings.problem: A command preset created by the toast test was never deleted, and the copy button was located without disambiguation, so a second run would find two rows sharing one label and fail on strict mode -- a failure the spec caused itself.
findings.resolution: Presets carrying this spec's label prefix are cleared before the row is created and again in teardown, and the locator takes the first match.

findings.problem: expect.poll compared a live value against an operand read once before the press. Raising reindexes the whole stack, so the frozen operand named a z-index the stack no longer had and the poll would have timed out on a correct implementation.
findings.resolution: Both operands are now read inside the polled callback, as a single difference.

findings.problem: The covered-window press was dispatched at the node, which bypasses the hit test and so never showed the covered window was reachable at all.
findings.resolution: A real mouse click at a point computed to lie inside the back window and outside the front one, with an elementFromPoint check that the point resolves to a window surface. The nested-content case keeps the dispatch on purpose, since what it isolates is the event phase.

findings.problem: The editor minimum size is retyped rather than imported.
findings.resolution: Not resolved: EditorWindow does not export the constant, and this task's file list is the spec alone. Reported.

findings.problem: Four helpers are duplicated from the sibling entry spec instead of living in helpers.ts.
findings.resolution: Not resolved: helpers.ts is outside this task's file list. Reported.

req-mapping.result: eleven test titles equal the eleven test_symbol values; req_id and ac_refs match the sidecar task

gate.note: all CRITICAL and HIGH findings resolved in iteration 2 of the draft; two LOW deferred for scope and reported
